name: Montreal Construction Oracle
description: Query Montreal building permit data from the city's Open Data portal. Filter by borough and issuance date, or surface large-scale projects. Data is sourced from ~550 000 permits spanning decades of construction activity.

tools.name: get_recent_permits
tools.description: Return building permits issued in the given Montreal borough within the last N days. Borough matching is case-insensitive and supports partial names (e.g. 'plateau' matches 'Le Plateau-Mont-Royal').

borough.description: Borough (arrondissement) name to filter by. Case-insensitive, partial match supported. Use list_boroughs() to see all 19 available names.

days.description: Number of days back to search from today. Defaults to 7.

tools.name: get_high_value_permits
tools.description: Return large-scale building permits filtered by estimated work cost. NOTE: the Montreal Open Data CSV does not currently publish the 'cout_travaux_estimes' column. This tool uses 'nb_logements' (housing unit count) as a scale proxy: min_cost is divided by 100 000 to derive the minimum unit threshold. Results are sorted largest-first. The tool will automatically switch to real cost data if the column appears in a future dataset update.

min_cost.description: Minimum estimated cost in CAD. Translated to a housing-unit threshold (min_cost / 100 000) while the cost column is unavailable. Defaults to 100 000.

tools.name: list_boroughs
tools.description: List all 19 distinct borough (arrondissement) names found in the permit dataset. Use the returned names as input to get_recent_permits().

tools.name: reload_data
tools.description: Clear the session cache and re-download the permit CSV from the Montreal Open Data portal. Useful if the dataset has been updated since the server started.
